public-site.module.name: Public site
public-site.module.description: The public pages: what's on, a page for each production, the archive of past shows and the calendar feed.
public-site.settings.archive.public.help: When off, every past production, the list of past shows and archived seasons answer "not found". Current shows are unaffected, and turning it back on restores everything.
public-site.settings.archive.from-year.h: Past shows that opened before this year are left out of the archive. Leave it empty to show everything.
public-site.settings.listing.cancelled-v: Keep a cancelled performance on the production's page, marked as cancelled, until its date has passed.
public-site.whats-on.title: What's on
public-site.whats-on.description: Everything with a date still to come, soonest first.
public-site.whats-on.empty: Nothing is on at the moment
public-site.whats-on.empty-description: New shows appear here as soon as their dates are announced.
public-site.whats-on.none-match-descript: Nothing with a date to come matches every filter you chose.
public-site.archive.title: Past shows
public-site.archive.description: Everything we have staged, year by year.
public-site.archive.search: Find a show, company or person
public-site.archive.too-short: Type at least three letters of a word to search.
public-site.archive.no-results-descripti: Try a different spelling, or fewer words.
public-site.archive.empty-description: Shows appear here once their last performance has ended.
public-site.production.no-advisories: This {production} has no staging effects or content warnings.
public-site.production.no-effects: This {production} has no staging effects to warn about.
public-site.production.asked-heading: You asked to be told about
public-site.production.tell-note: Use the bell to always see a warning without opening this list. Your choices stay in this browser only; the theatre never sees them.
public-site.production.dates-soon: Dates are still to be announced.
public-site.venues.title: Venues
public-site.venues.description: Where our shows are on: addresses, getting there and access.
public-site.venue.no-access: The theatre has not yet described the access here. Please get in touch to ask.
public-site.venue.nothing-on: Nothing is on here at the moment.
public-site.season.empty-description: {Productions} appear here as soon as they are announced.
public-site.navigation.readiness.label: Site readiness
public-site.abilities.readiness.view.lab: See what the public site still lacks
public-site.settings.search.hidden.label: Turn search engines away
public-site.settings.search.hidden.help: While on, every page asks search engines not to list it and robots.txt turns them away. Turn it off once the site is ready, and search engines will start to find it.
public-site.readiness.description: What the public site still lacks, with what needs doing first. Each line links to where it is put right, or names the file to edit.
public-site.readiness.hidden.title: Search engines are being turned away
public-site.readiness.hidden.outstanding: Put right what is listed below, then let search engines in.
public-site.readiness.hidden.ready: Nothing is outstanding. Let search engines in when you are ready to be found.
public-site.readiness.visible.title: Search engines may list the site
public-site.readiness.visible.descriptio: Pages still marked as starter text, or marked noindex, are kept out of search results all the same.
public-site.readiness.show.consequence: Search engines may list the site from now on. Pages still marked as starter text stay out of results.
public-site.readiness.show.consequence-o: 1 thing on this list is still unfinished. Search engines may list the site from now on; pages still marked as starter text stay out of results.
{count} things on this list are still unfinished. Search engines may list the site from now on; pages still marked as starter text stay out of results.
public-site.readiness.show.done: Search engines may now list the site
public-site.readiness.hide.consequence: Every page asks search engines not to list it. Pages already listed drop out over the following days or weeks.
public-site.readiness.hide.done: Search engines are being turned away
public-site.readiness.pages.title: Pages with starter text
public-site.readiness.pages.none: Every page has been made your own.
public-site.readiness.pages.line: Still marked as starter text. Edit {file}, then remove the line "placeholder: true".
public-site.readiness.brand.title: Brand
public-site.readiness.brand.none: The theatre's name and logo are set.
public-site.readiness.brand.name: The theatre's name
public-site.readiness.brand.name-help: Not set, so pages and emails use a stand-in.
public-site.readiness.brand.logo-help: Not set, so the header shows the theatre's name instead.
public-site.readiness.images.title: Images without a text description
public-site.readiness.images.none: Every image has a text description.
public-site.readiness.images.logo-help: Has no text description for people who cannot see it.
public-site.readiness.images.logo-dark-h: Has no text description for people who cannot see it.
public-site.readiness.images.production-: A public image of this production has no text description.
public-site.readiness.images.page-help: The image {src} has no text description. Edit {file} and describe it between the square brackets.
public-site.readiness.components.title: Parts of pages from a switched-off module
public-site.readiness.components.none: Every part a page uses is switched on.
public-site.readiness.components.line: Uses {tag}, but {module} is switched off, so nothing shows in its place. Switch it on, or edit {file}.
public-site.readiness.settings.title: Settings a page quotes
public-site.readiness.settings.none: Every setting a page quotes is set.
public-site.readiness.settings.line: Quoted on {page}, but not set, so nothing shows there.
public-site.readiness.venues.title: Venue access
public-site.readiness.venues.none: Every venue says what access it has.
public-site.readiness.venues.line: No access features recorded, so its page says nothing about access.
public-site.readiness.productions.title: Productions
public-site.readiness.productions.none: No production has anything left from the move to content warnings.
public-site.readiness.productions.level-: A content warning's level was assumed. Set the real level and save.
public-site.readiness.productions.effect: Published with no answer on staging effects. List them or confirm there are none.
public-site.readiness.card.line.one: 1 thing on the public site is unfinished
public-site.readiness.card.line.other: {count} things on the public site are unfinished
public-site.readiness.policies.title: Policies
public-site.readiness.policies.none: Every policy is written, reviewed and has the facts it states.
public-site.readiness.policies.unwritten: Only you can write this section, so it is left off the page. Write it at {file}.
public-site.readiness.policies.stale: The default wording has changed since yours was written. Compare {file} with it, then update its based-on line.
public-site.readiness.policies.setting: Not set, so the policies say less than they should.
public-site.readiness.policies.unreviewe: This is default text. Have a competent person read it for your theatre, then add it to the reviewed policies.
